# תרגול מבחני תאוריה

> Free Israeli driving-theory practice for learner drivers. Mock exams in the real test format, topic study, and optional free signup for error-focused follow-up questions.

אתר זה מיועד ללומדי נהיגה בישראל שמתכוננים למבחן התאוריה. אפשר לתרגל מבחנים מדומים בפורמט הבחינה האמיתית (30 שאלות, ציון עובר 26/30), ללמוד לפי נושאים, ואחרי הרשמה חינם לקבל שאלות שחוזרות על הטעויות של המשתמש.

Independent study tool. Not affiliated with the Israeli Ministry of Transport or the Licensing Authority. Hebrew UI, RTL, works in the browser on phone and desktop. No app install. Practice is free; signup is free and only needed to save progress.

## Product

- Homepage: mock-exam intro, guest demo quiz, FAQ. No account required to start.
- Mock tests: configurable length and category, timed sessions, option shuffling, post-attempt review.
- Adaptive practice: after signup, weak questions are oversampled so learners spend time on mistakes.
- Learning: topic study and a matching game.
- License classes: B, A, C, C1, D, tractor.
- Legal: privacy, terms, accessibility statement.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): what the site is and a guest demo

## Audience

Learner drivers in Israel preparing for the official theory exam. Not a government site and not a driving school.

## Optional

Authenticated areas (`/profile`, `/practice`, `/learning`, `/admin`) require a session and are not useful to anonymous crawlers.
